image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a meat cleaver against a solid black background. The image features a large, rectangular steel blade with a polished metallic finish and a visible circular hole near the top corner. The handle is made of wood with a visible rivet, attached to the tang via a metal bolster. The lighting highlights the texture of the steel and wood.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the knife as a cleaver versus other kitchen knives.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or inconsistent reflections on the metallic surface which are common AI artifacts.
To verify the structural integrity of the connection between the handle, bolster, and blade, ensuring no fusion or floating parts.

focus_areas: Metallic reflection consistency on the blade
Sharpness and continuity of the blade edge
Structural logic of the handle-to-blade connection (tang/rivet)
Background uniformity (checking for noise or gradient artifacts)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the metal bolster and the wooden handle. AI often blurs this boundary or creates illogical rivet placements. Also, inspect the 'hole' in the blade; ensure it is a clean geometric circle and not a distorted blob, as this is a specific functional feature of cleavers.
